model-policy-zai-qualification.observable_outcome: Both exact Z.ai models become eligible only after deterministic policy validation and real Pool Worker qualification.
model-policy-zai-qualification.primary_invariant: Only exact qualified models route; Moonshot is fallback-only and evaluator tier is never lower than builder tier.
model-policy-zai-qualification.acceptance_oracle: Focused registry/policy/preflight suites plus retained real qualification reports for GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3.
model-policy-zai-qualification.production_seam: Canonical model registry, tie-capable Worker routing/preflight configuration, and real provider qualification boundary; probing runtime remains post-launch.
model-policy-zai-qualification.blast_radius: Model Routing and Evaluation, Worker preflight, launcher authentication/usage evidence, and paid qualification commands.
non_goals: Empirical model calibration or threshold derivation.
Approval of aliases, wildcards, future Z.ai models, or new providers.
Modification of retained Pool Proof evidence.

exceptions.cross_domain: Exact authorization is unsafe without both deterministic Model Routing policy and executable Agent Execution qualification.
exceptions.multi_contract: Registry, capability-tier, routing, preflight, and qualification-report contracts jointly define one model's eligibility.
exceptions.multi_suite: Policy/preflight tests and real paid qualification evidence establish different halves of the same eligibility claim.

parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.observable_outcome: One reviewed Agent Pool task runs through the public Minimal Pool Runtime using only validated manifest parameters.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.primary_invariant: Repository-specific behavior exists only in a bounded immutable manifest and independent verifier, never hard-coded runner policy.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.acceptance_oracle: A parameterized repository fixture completes red-to-green with exact commit/path/cleanup verification while hostile manifests fail before paid work.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.production_seam: Pool Proof Harness composition over public Minimal Pool Runtime, launcher, sandbox, persistence, and Verification interfaces.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.blast_radius: Harness manifest parsing, runner composition, target verifier, candidate reports, and focused tests.
non_goals: Activating CRAFTS, grading, GitHub delivery, or production service operation.

exceptions.cross_domain: Harness, Agent Execution, and Verification must be exercised together to prove parameterization is real.
exceptions.multi_contract: Task and verifier manifests are separate because Worker instructions cannot define their own acceptance oracle.

credential-strip-zai-dogfood.observable_outcome: A qualified Z.ai Worker produces an independently verified Agent Pool commit that strips copied provider credentials without breaking offline resolution.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.primary_invariant: Private models.json contains only required provider metadata; authentication remains solely in private auth storage.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.acceptance_oracle: Credential-canary red/green test plus runner-owned commit, path, isolation, resolution, and cleanup verification.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.production_seam: Launcher provider-metadata projection exercised through the reviewed dogfood manifest.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.blast_radius: copyProviderModels implementation, focused launcher tests, one paid dogfood attempt, and one separate report.
non_goals: Generic secret scanning or provider-token rotation.
Full CRAFTS, grading, delivery, or arbitrary-repository authorization.

exceptions.multi_contract: The security fix and dogfood report are one outcome because the real run is the acceptance oracle for safe self-improvement.

direct-task-first-service.observable_outcome: An authenticated caller submits a bounded direct task and observes a durably identified real Pool Worker result without decomposition.
direct-task-first-service.primary_invariant: Direct tasks skip only decomposition/Gate 1; criteria, identity, persistence, readiness, topology-free dispatch, and mandatory Gate 2 remain authoritative.
direct-task-first-service.acceptance_oracle: HTTP/domain/store/dispatch tests and one service-level real fixture execution.
direct-task-first-service.production_seam: POST /tasks through Work Intake, Orchestration persistence/frontier, identifier-only queue, and Agent Execution composition.
direct-task-first-service.blast_radius: Work Intake HTTP/domain boundary, orchestration composition/status, runtime adapter, authentication, and tests.
non_goals: POST /specs, decomposition, Gate 1, or Graphify scheduling.
GitHub delivery or broad public tenancy.

exceptions.cross_domain: Intake, persistence, and execution are inseparable for the user-observable service outcome.
exceptions.multi_contract: HTTP input, accepted work, queue envelope, and attempt contracts deliberately narrow at each trust boundary.
exceptions.multi_suite: Each domain suite plus a service-level test is required to prove the vertical slice.

full-crafts-attempt-runtime.observable_outcome: A production direct-task attempt completes the governed CRAFTS lifecycle with schema-valid append-only artifacts.
full-crafts-attempt-runtime.primary_invariant: No phase advances without valid durable predecessor evidence, correct capabilities, and valid model independence.
full-crafts-attempt-runtime.acceptance_oracle: Full Worker fixture proving sequencing, security checkpoint, bounded repair loops, capability denial, artifact revisions, transcript handling, and cleanup.
full-crafts-attempt-runtime.production_seam: Fresh Worker conductor and Orchestration phase-artifact persistence.
full-crafts-attempt-runtime.blast_radius: Full Worker profile/skill/agents/contracts, attempt runtime, artifact store, transcript adapter, and focused tests.

exceptions.cross_domain: Agent Execution sequencing and Orchestration append-only persistence form one phase-gate invariant.
exceptions.multi_contract: Execution context, attempt, phase artifact, security checkpoint, and transcript-object contracts are required handoffs in one lifecycle.
exceptions.multi_suite: Worker preflight and domain behavior tests cover independent enforcement layers.

grading-and-audit-verdicts.observable_outcome: Every completed CRAFTS attempt receives one tamper-evident composite verdict traceable to criteria, models, commits, suites, evidence, and cost.
grading-and-audit-verdicts.primary_invariant: No agent claim can substitute for deterministic Tier 1, actual independent Tier 2 provenance, or immutable audit linkage.
grading-and-audit-verdicts.acceptance_oracle: Verification and persistence mutation/hostile-input tests plus an end-to-end graded fixture.
grading-and-audit-verdicts.production_seam: Verification evidence validation and Orchestration append-only audit ingestion/query.
grading-and-audit-verdicts.blast_radius: Tier-1/Tier-2 contracts, verifier services, evidence consumers, SQLite records, audit queries, and tests.
non_goals: Eval calibration or empirical winner publication.

exceptions.cross_domain: A verdict without durable audit persistence, or persistence without verification, cannot establish the observable outcome.
exceptions.multi_contract: Tier 1, Tier 2, composite, routing provenance, evidence locator, and audit contracts compose one verdict chain.
exceptions.multi_suite: Verification and Orchestration tests establish both validation and append-only durability.

controller-failure-budget-recovery.observable_outcome: The controller reaches one correct auditable terminal state across failure, spend exhaustion, restart, duplicate delivery, and discovered work.
controller-failure-budget-recovery.primary_invariant: SQLite-authoritative fenced state prevents duplicate paid attempts and silent topology/scope mutation while unrelated branches continue.
controller-failure-budget-recovery.acceptance_oracle: Deterministic fault injection across retry, budget, lease, queue, migration, result, reconciliation, discovery, and cleanup windows.
controller-failure-budget-recovery.production_seam: Orchestration lifecycle state machine, queue adapter, leases, result handling, reconciliation, budgets, and escalation.
controller-failure-budget-recovery.blast_radius: Orchestration contracts/store/services, queue integration, cleanup recovery, migrations, operational audit, and tests.
non_goals: ADR-038 merge-based dependency unlock or provider hard spend controls.

exceptions.cross_domain: Owned-resource recovery consumes Agent Execution outcomes but Orchestration alone mutates lifecycle truth.
exceptions.multi_contract: Retry, budget, lease, queue, result, discovery, and reconciliation contracts share terminal-state semantics and cannot contradict each other.
exceptions.multi_suite: State-machine, persistence, queue, sandbox-recovery, and migration suites cover distinct interruption boundaries.

adr015-github-gate2-delivery.observable_outcome: Machine-green connected-component work reaches one reviewable GitHub PR and cannot complete without authorized human Gate 2.
adr015-github-gate2-delivery.primary_invariant: Only reverified component commits with complete provenance enter trusted host-side delivery; GitHub never grants Worker authority.
adr015-github-gate2-delivery.acceptance_oracle: Delivery/integration tests with replayed/forged events and one controlled PR lifecycle through human Gate 2.
adr015-github-gate2-delivery.production_seam: Integration re-verification, ADR-015 PR assembly, trusted GitHub adapter, Gate 2, and governed revision intake.
adr015-github-gate2-delivery.blast_radius: Integration and Delivery domain, orchestration delivery state, GitHub configuration/webhooks, credentials, and tests.
non_goals: Automatic execution of comments or target deployment.

exceptions.cross_domain: Verification, Orchestration, and Delivery are inseparable for a governed reviewable GitHub outcome.
exceptions.multi_contract: Component manifest, commit provenance, verdict, PR, webhook, review, and revision identities jointly prevent bypass and replay.
exceptions.multi_suite: Integration, delivery-adapter, webhook, credential-isolation, and end-to-end PR tests cover separate external boundaries.

single-host-functional-pool-deployment.observable_outcome: A fresh single host can deploy, run, recover, restore, and audit the complete direct-task-to-Gate-2 service.
single-host-functional-pool-deployment.primary_invariant: Every live effect and recovery decision is health-visible, least-privilege, durable, correlated, restorable, and backed by prior node contracts.
single-host-functional-pool-deployment.acceptance_oracle: Empty-host deployment, restart-window tests, encrypted backup/restore drill, credential canaries, one real direct-task-to-Gate-2 trace, and complete hash traversal.
single-host-functional-pool-deployment.production_seam: Single-host service composition and operational controls over already implemented application capabilities.
single-host-functional-pool-deployment.blast_radius: Deployment definitions, service configuration, health/logging, backup/restore, migrations, retention, operator docs, and system tests.
non_goals: New business capability, free-form specs, Gate 1, Graphify, eval calibration, or agent-assisted probes.
ADR-037/038, multi-host/multi-tenant operation, formal SLO/on-call, or automatic target deployment.

exceptions.cross_domain: Deployment and one end-to-end trace necessarily compose all previously accepted runtime domains without changing their policy.
exceptions.multi_contract: Service health, secret, backup, restore, migration, retention, and trace contracts jointly define recoverable deployment readiness.
exceptions.multi_suite: Deterministic, Docker, retained-evidence, restart, backup/restore, and real end-to-end lanes establish different release properties.
